definitions.name: O1A.DELTAS
definitions.note: bracket String to its Vector of +1/-1 steps (empty for '')

definitions.name: O1A.BSTEP
definitions.body: 'QC' BIND 'QA' BIND QA CHARS -1 DROP JOIN QA QC 2 COLLECT JOIN QA CHARS -1 GET [ '(' ')' '[' ']' ] [ '?' '(' '?' '[' ] RECORD QC GET EQ SELECT
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step over a '.'-based bracket stack String: pop on a matching close, else push the char

definitions.name: O1A.BREDUCE
definitions.note: bracket String to '.' followed by what remains after deleting matched pairs

definitions.name: O1A.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LG' BIND LG [ 0 GET ] MAP LG [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries to Record name -> summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: O1A.LWORDS
definitions.note: String to its space-separated words in lower case

definitions.name: O1A.RSTEP
definitions.body: 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 DROP RX RA -1 GET 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT RA RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RA -1 GET 0 GET RX EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD step for run-length encoding: extend the last [ value count ] pair or append [ x 1 ]

definitions.name: O1A.RLE
definitions.note: Vector of integers to its run-length encoding [ [ value count ] ... ]

definitions.name: O1A.USTEP
definitions.body: 'UX' BIND 'UA' BIND UX UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 UX UA 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: SCAN step over [ prev len ]: len+1 when x > prev, else 1

definitions.name: O1A.RUNSTEP
definitions.body: 'KT' BIND 'KA' BIND KA 1 ADD 0 KT SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step over truths: current run length of TRUE (acc+1 or 0)

definitions.name: O1A.FSTEP
definitions.body: 'FX' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FX FX NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step for forward fill: the element, or the accumulator when the element is NIL

definitions.name: O1A.RATSTEP
definitions.body: 'TX' BIND 'TA' BIND TA 0 GET 'TP' BIND TX TX TP DIV NIL TX NIL? NOT TP NIL? NOT AND SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: SCAN step over [ prev ratio ]: [ x x/prev ], ratio NIL when either is NIL

definitions.name: O1A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS MS LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MS MS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector

solutions.brackets.depth: O1A.DELTAS 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.brackets.balanced_prefix: 'PS' BIND '.' 1 COLLECT PS CHARS '.' [ O1A.BSTEP ] SCAN CONCAT [ '.' EQ ] MAP 'PT' BIND 0 PS CHARS LENGTH RANGE 0 PT SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.ledger.debtors: O1A.BYNAME 'LB' BIND LB KEYS LB VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
solutions.ledger.largest_entry: 'LE' BIND LE LE [ 1 GET ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.messy.title: G0A.WORDS [ LOWER G0B.CAP ] MAP G0B.SPACED
solutions.prose.longest: G0A.WORDS 'PW' BIND PW PW [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
solutions.prose.initials_of_long: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS LENGTH 3 GT ] FILTER [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
solutions.runs.upruns: 'UV' BIND UV UV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ O1A.USTEP ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.runs.second_largest: UNIQUE SORT 'SV' BIND SV -2 GET NIL SV LENGTH 1 GT SELECT
solutions.runs.majority: 'MJ' BIND MJ TALLY 'MT' BIND MT G0A.TOPKEY NIL MT VALUES G0C.MAXV 2 MUL MJ LENGTH GT SELECT
solutions.sensor.filled: 'SF' BIND SF SF [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER 0 GET [ O1A.FSTEP ] SCAN
solutions.sensor.gap_count: [ NIL? ] MAP 'GM' BIND GM FALSE 1 COLLECT GM -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND G0B.COUNT
solutions.sensor.longest_gap: [ NIL? ] MAP 0 [ O1A.RUNSTEP ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
solutions.sensor.ratios: NIL NIL 2 COLLECT [ O1A.RATSTEP ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP 1 DROP
solutions.sensor.scaled: 'SC' BIND SC [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER G0C.MAXV 'SM' BIND SC [ SM DIV ] MAP
solutions.series.mad: 'MD' BIND MD MD O1A.MEDIAN SUB O1A.ABS O1A.MEDIAN
solutions.series.moving3: 'MW' BIND MW -2 DROP MW 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD MW 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
solutions.series.runmax: 'RM' BIND RM RM 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
